% adjustbox given pdfTeX's driver option, which it passes to graphicx and
% trimclip, then graphicx and trimclip loaded again with the option, which
% is no clash; with hyperref. \clipbox, \adjustbox's trim and clip, and
% \trimbox, in a paragraph, in a footnote, and in a theorem. Each box's
% text is the same as without the option, where trimclip uses its dvips
% driver.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[pdftex]{adjustbox}
\usepackage[pdftex]{graphicx}
\usepackage[pdftex]{trimclip}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\section{Boxes}\label{boxes}

Clip: \clipbox{0pt 0pt 0pt 0pt}{clipped text}. After the clip.

Adjust: \adjustbox{trim=0pt,clip}{adjusted text}. After the adjustment.

Trim: \trimbox{0pt 0pt 0pt 0pt}{trimmed text}. After the trim.

A note.\footnote{Note: \clipbox{0pt 0pt 0pt 0pt}{noted clip}. After the
note's clip.}

\begin{theorem}
Theorem: \trimbox{0pt 0pt 0pt 0pt}{theorem trim}. See
section~\ref{boxes}.
\end{theorem}
\end{document}
